propositions: The resolved_statuses config keys became inert after task f020 deleted the inbound absence-probe port, which was their only reader via classify_probe_response.
Both jira.resolved_statuses and reconciler.resolved_statuses were live and documented operator-facing keys in shipped release v0.10.1, making hard removal without operator sign-off an upgrade hazard.
The keys must be accepted and validated unchanged, emit a registered deprecation warning naming removal in v1.0.0, and have their write-only DC transport plumbing removed.
Documentation must be updated to describe both keys as deprecated (inert, warns, scheduled for v1.0.0 removal, tracked on follow-up ticket f408-64ad-ee41-46b6).
A follow-up hard-removal ticket must be filed for future operator sign-off to delete the keys via warn-class tombstones following the code_health.enabled precedent.
